description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'union_bm25_pos_logreg' baseline: BM25 word + POS-sequence feature union (English) + Logistic Regression.
model: union_bm25_pos_logreg (BM25 word + POS-sequence feature union (English) + Logistic Regression)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'union_bm25_pos_logreg', group(s): feature_engineering, linguistic); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate.
